# Feature `distro:systemd-resolved`

Distro feature `systemd-resolved`:

Include support and use `systemd-resolved` as the main DNS name resolver in `glibc` Name Service Switch. This is a DNS resolver daemon from `systemd`.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/features.html#distro-features
